CustomField.description: How many SMS records the SMSProcessor queueable pre-processes per chained job. Higher values shorten the queueable chain (fewer re-enqueues) at the cost of more work per transaction. Capped at 2000.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Records the SMS pre-processor handles per chained job. Higher = shorter job chain. Max 2000.
CustomField.label: SMS Processor Records Per Chunk
